idea-plugin.name: AiNxt Code
idea-plugin.description: AiNxt Code — governed AI coding agent for JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, GoLand, WebStorm…). A JCEF tool window that spawns the governed AiNxt Code CLI over the Agent Client Protocol, so all CLI guardrails (policy engine, egress/exec allowlists, Sovereign approvals, audit) apply. Shares the same UI as the AiNxt VS Code extension.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0
  • Initial OSS release — no organisation-specific defaults; fully configurable via Settings → Tools → AiNxt.
  • IntelliJ Settings panel added (Gateway URL, API Key, Model, Binary Path, Allow Insecure, Load Profile).
  • Configuration profile system — load bundled or your own defaults via the profile picker.
  • File I/O now uses IntelliJ VFS API (reads live editor buffers; writes trigger undo history).
  • Terminal handler added (terminal/execute).
  • clientVersion now read from PluginManagerCore (not hardcoded).
  • AINXT_HOME passed to agent spawn environment.
